title: A finished head blocked only by a host fault is resubmitted when the fault clears, without waiting for a worker slot
description: GY-3335: a worker whose complete fails on a stubbed trial-host fault blocks naming its committed head; after master unblock, with the worker role at its concurrency limit, the loop submits that exact head itself, and the item reaches review without any worker launch. A blocker that names no finished head sends the item to a worker as today. The command step proves the whole path on a real store: the blocked record, the cycle's resubmission through the production effect wiring, the engine's submit as the next attempt, and the worker-as-today refusal.

steps.name: one cycle after the unblock: the finished head is submitted by the loop, with no worker launch
